description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת תנאים הקשורים לתשלומי פרמיה, ביטול ודיווח על תביעות בפוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום. הפוליסה מאפשרת ביקורת על ספרי ה'מבוטח' ורישומיו, וכן קובעת את הריבית על סכומים שלא שולמו בזמן, בהתאם לפרסומי בנק ישראל. ביטול הפוליסה אינו משפיע על חובת המבוטח להסדיר את הסכום הפיגור עד לביטול, וכן אינו פוגע בזכויות לתביעה בגין 'אירוע זיהום' שהתרחש לפני הביטול, בתנאי שהתביעה מדווחת בכתב בתקופת דיווח מורחבת. הפוליסה כוללת סעיפים הנוגעים ל'תביעה', 'אירוע זיהום', 'עלויות ניקיון', ו'הפסד'.
notable_values: insured: duty to settle overdue amount
pollution event: claim reporting during extended period

sketch:
(i) Any amount not paid timely shall bear interest differentials, as published by the Bank of Israel, for the overdue period, which shall be paid to the us at the time of settling the sum overdue and as an integral part thereof
(ii) Cancellation  of  the  insurance  under  the  terms  of  this  clause  shall  not adversely affect the "insured's" duty to settle the amount overdue relating to  the  period  up  to  the  aforementioned  cancellation,  including  our expenses.
(iii) Cancellation of insurance as aforementioned shall not adversely affect the rights  of  any  "claim"  under  the  Policy  in  respect  of  "pollution  event" which occurred prior to the cancellation of the insurance, if the "claim" is reported to us in writing during an applicable extended reporting period.
If  we  cancel,  subject  to  any  minimum  earned  premium  that  may  apply,  the return premium will be calculated on a 'pro rata' basis.  If the "named insured" cancels, subject to any minimum earned premium that may apply, there may be no  return  premium  or  the  return  premium  will  be  calculated  on  a  'pro  rata' basis.

טבלה: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח אחריות זיהום
This table outlines conditions related to premium payments, cancellation, and claims reporting for a Pollution Liability Insurance policy. It details how overdue amounts accrue interest and how cancellation affects both premium returns and existing claims.
ממדים: Cancellation/Payment Conditions, Policy Terms

(i) Any amount not paid timely shall bear interest differentials, as published by the Bank of Israel, for the overdue period, which shall be paid to the us at the time of settling the sum overdue and as an integral part thereof
(ii) Cancellation  of  the  insurance  under  the  terms  of  this  clause  shall  not adversely affect the "insured's" duty to settle the amount overdue relating to  the  period  up  to  the  aforementioned  cancellation,  including  our expenses.
(iii) Cancellation of insurance as aforementioned shall not adversely affect the rights  of  any  "claim"  under  the  Policy  in  respect  of  "pollution  event" which occurred prior to the cancellation of the insurance, if the "claim" is reported to us in writing during an applicable extended reporting period.
If  we  cancel,  subject  to  any  minimum  earned  premium  that  may  apply,  the return premium will be calculated on a 'pro rata' basis.  If the "named insured" cancels, subject to any minimum earned premium that may apply, there may be no  return  premium  or  the  return  premium  will  be  calculated  on  a  'pro  rata' basis.
